name: IronClaw Edit-Test Loop (Phase 2)
description: Phase 2: IronClaw reads a file, writes a test, creates a PR, and the PR must pass CI. This validates the full read-edit-test loop required for self-improving agents. The target is adding unit tests for parseCapabilities() and HasCapability() in gateway/identity.go, which currently have zero test coverage.
process: You MUST use the exec tool to call rj-tool for EVERY operation. Do NOT guess or fabricate file contents. Do NOT rely on memory or training data.
STEP 1: Read the target file. Execute: exec({"command": "/workspace/bin/rj-tool github_fetch owner=tinyland-inc repo=remote-juggler path=gateway/identity.go"})
STEP 2: Study the functions parseCapabilities(header string) []string and (CallerIdentity).HasCapability(cap string) bool. Understand their behavior from the source code you just read.
STEP 3: Read the existing test file to understand test patterns. Execute: exec({"command": "/workspace/bin/rj-tool github_fetch owner=tinyland-inc repo=remote-juggler path=gateway/resolver_test.go"})
STEP 4: Create a feature branch. Execute: exec({"command": "/workspace/bin/rj-tool github_create_branch owner=tinyland-inc repo=remote-juggler branch_name=ic-add-identity-tests"})

STEP 5: Write a new test file gateway/identity_test.go with tests for parseCapabilities and HasCapability. The file MUST: (a) use package main_test or package main, matching existing test files, (b) import testing, (c) test parseCapabilities with cases: empty string, single cap, multiple caps, caps with spaces, trailing comma, (d) test HasCapability with cases: has capability, missing capability, empty capabilities. Use github_patch_file or github_update_file to create the file. Execute: exec({"command": "/workspace/bin/rj-tool github_update_file owner=tinyland-inc repo=remote-juggler path=gateway/identity_test.go content=<YOUR_TEST_CODE> message=test: add unit tests for parseCapabilities and HasCapability branch=ic-add-identity-tests"})

STEP 6: Create a pull request. Execute: exec({"command": "/workspace/bin/rj-tool github_create_pr owner=tinyland-inc repo=remote-juggler title=test: add unit tests for parseCapabilities and HasCapability head=ic-add-identity-tests body=Adds test coverage for two untested functions in identity.go. Created by IronClaw agent as Phase 2 proof of edit-test capability."})
STEP 7: Report the PR URL and number. Your report MUST include the exact PR URL returned by the tool.

metrics.successCriteria: Agent created a PR with a new test file that passes CI (go test ./... green). PR authored by rj-agent-bot[bot], diff is non-trivial, tests actually test the target functions.
